note: Round-22 coverage (DECISIONS-r22.md E5, E8, E10; architecture.md §3, §4.1, §4.3, G-03, G-07, R-15). Every expected value is from ref/wire.py (W.Home) driven with the same entries. Run after probes-decided.json, in this order: E8-setup builds the paging space, E5-setup the space E5a-E5d and E7a use.

vectors.title: setup: alice creates `pg:a.localhost`, adds bob and generates 1001 tasks (one more than maxStateItems, 1,000)

state returns the maps in pages: page 1 holds roles, roleHistory and the oldest 1,000 of 1001 tasks, with next `1003.2.2.1000.0.0.0.0` (head, then one offset per paged map); the cursor returns the last task (every other member was complete); a cursor excludes `at` and `effect`; `state` takes no `after`
vectors.expect: page 1: 1,000 tasks + next; page 2: 1 task, no next

vectors.title: a malformed cursor is invalid (not a string, not the format of §3, a head beyond the current head, an offset beyond its map, a leading zero, too few offsets); a reader who may read nothing of the space gets not_found for a valid cursor

state {effect}: one state holding only that effect with space, head, home and policy, and no next; an unknown effect is not_found, a non-string effect invalid, `limit` is no member of `state`; a stranger gets not_found
an integer of 2^53 or more in args, in opaque Json or in an entry is invalid on the request's own id (usable id): the connection stays open; 2^53-1 is fine
vectors.expect: invalid on the id, the connection open

vectors.title: an integer of 2^53 or more with no usable id (id itself 2^53, absent, 0, a string, negative): id 0, invalid, and the server closes the connection
order of the frame checks: an oversized integer and a malformed frame are invalid before authentication; before hello a well-formed call with bad args is denied (args come last)
setup: alice creates `vo:a.localhost`, adds bob, bob posts a message, alice removes bob (state for E5a-E5d)
dedupe before Policy (steps 1, 5): a stored entry of a removed member gets its receipt again; a new one is denied
routing before shape (steps 2, 3): a malformed entry for a foreign space is moved, whatever its kind; for an unknown local space or for this server's own space it is invalid
shape before the key and the signature (steps 3, 4): an unknown keyId is denied, the same entry malformed is invalid; a forged signature of a member is invalid, not allowed
signature before Policy (steps 4, 5), shape before Policy (3, 5): for a non-member a genuine entry is denied, a forged one is invalid, an unknown key is denied, a malformed one is invalid

state {at}: the state after record `at` (head = at); a former member reads it while they were in, but not the head; a member who joined later reads an earlier state; at as 0, past the head, a string or a boolean is invalid; `read` has no `at`
vectors.expect: state at `at`, denied for the former member at the head

vectors.title: read {follow, limit: 2} on a backlog of 5: two records, then the live records from the head at registration on (seq 6): records 3-5 are a visible gap that read {after: 2} fills
vectors.expect: records 1, 2, then 6; the gap re-read gives 3, 4, 5

vectors.title: non-empty knownHeads, in read and in hello: the head receipt of each listed space the asker may read (a stranger gets none, an unknown space none), whatever the listed receipt says; an empty list still gets a `heads` item
vectors.expect: heads item before the records; hello.knownHeads

vectors.title: a stranger reads a profile space: its first record is the server's space.create (author @:S, signed by the server key, body.profile with the actor's key, content {name}, receipt pins {@:S: 0})

notices (G-03): the home signals the actor's own profile space when a member.set gives it guest/member/owner or a message names it in `to`; none and banned send nothing; a stranger subscribed to that profile sees nothing
vectors.expect: signals {type: notice, space, seq} from @:S for seqs 2, 3, 6, 7 only
